sourceBrief: The Small Boat: replace the rejected front-facing conditioned source with a newly generated broadside paper schooner. One navy/ivory folded hull/sails faces right in photographic blue sea with warm side light. prompt: A macro photograph of a miniature origami schooner floating in real deep blue sea. One long navy folded paper hull, two cream triangular folded paper sails. Broadside profile, bow right, stern left. Low camera; horizon behind the boat. Warm afternoon side light, creased paper fibres, realistic water, shallow optical depth.
